title: Filtration behavior and associated mechanisms of kaolinite and illite with emphasis on pH effect
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44093-44101
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04866D, Paper
Open Access

Guolei Liu, Xinde Xu, Rongfeng Chen, Huaizhi Shao, Dongping Tao, Lu Yang, Xiangning Bu
The filterability and mechanisms of individual kaolinite and illite particles and their mixture have been investigated in aqueous solutions at different pH values by measuring the filtration rate and chord length distributions.
